item.title: Query Resource Events
item.description: This section describes how to query resource events. Resource events: Events for various resources such as application workloads, Jobs, pods, Services, Ingresses, etc. KubeSphere supports querying resource events within a user’s permission scope, whether as a regular user or a cluster administrator. Query Events as a Regular User Prerequisites The WizTelemetry Events extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. Query Resource Events Log in to the KubeSphere web console.
